releaseNotes: Zuriel version 2.6: Completed all 34 Deuteronomy chapter introductions in two study sections (1–17 and 18–34). Both sections are connected to the searchable offline Study Library with chapter-specific context, study questions, interpretive safeguards, KJV-checked references and Android offline-cache integration. Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus and Numbers chapter introductions remain complete.
